newsitem.title: FRANCE: UAP says too early for Eurotunnel figures.
newsitem.headline: UAP says too early for Eurotunnel figures.

text.p: French insurer UAP is one of the insurers of Eurotunnel, but it is too early to give figures on exposure or claims after the fire in the sub-sea rail tunnel between Britain and France, a UAP executive said on Tuesday.
"We are indeed one of the insurers and we will be the effective settler," said UAP France insurance executive in response to a query from Reuters.
"It's too early for figures. One would have to look to the experts from the operator. It is complex and we cannot give details."
He added that experts from Eurotunnel were assessing the damage and that UAP experts would be on the spot soon.
"We are insurers among others for the operator, that is Eurotunnel," he said.
UAP is involved in insurance of the infrastructure and the operatorm but not the rolling stock, he added.
